falsifier: The research hypothesis is weakened or rejected when untouched validation is nonpositive after nominal costs, worsens materially under stress, has profit factor at or below one, lacks either direction without a predeclared market-structure explanation, or is dominated by one event or asset. The revised experiment contract is invalidated by evidence hash drift, incomplete source-hour coverage, charging an out-of-window settlement, assigning an in-window settlement before it becomes observable, unreported trials, validation-driven tuning, holdout access, a single assumed GOLD fee state, or any execution-capable client.
limitations: The funding repair establishes causal accounting boundaries; it does not establish profitability or historical funding completeness beyond the validated requested interval.
Qualification proves exact current market identity and observable books, not profitability, fill quality, or continuous availability.
